about: Scripted answers for the fictional Jane Doe (cv_jane_doe.pdf) applying to job_ad_demo.txt. Every 'yes' is something her CV supports, plus her willingness to travel and to work 3 days in the Hamburg office (she lives in Hamburg). Terraform is not in her CV: no.
free_text: I have spent three years building a customer-facing RAG assistant for a freight booking platform, and Lumenpath's plan to answer customer questions from your documentation is the same problem at a larger scale. I want to keep building software that freight companies use every day.
